description: This file contains unit tests for the AuthorizationCodeRepository class within the OAuth module of the OrangeHRM system. It verifies functionality such as creating, persisting, revoking, and checking the revocation status of OAuth authorization codes.

classes.name: AuthorizationCodeRepositoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AuthorizationCodeRepository, verifying creation, persistence, revocation, and revocation status of OAuth authorization codes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures by populating test data from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: testGetNewAuthCode
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new AuthCodeEntity instance and verifies its initial state.

methods.name: testPersistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Tests persisting a new authorization code and verifies its storage and related entity fields.

methods.name: testPersistNewAuthCodeWithExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to persist a duplicate auth code throws a UniqueTokenIdentifierConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testRevokeAuthCode
methods.description: Tests revoking an existing authorization code and verifies its revoked status.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Ensures that revoking a non-existent auth code does not cause errors.

methods.name: testIsAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks the revoked status of various auth codes, ensuring correct boolean output.

methods.name: testIsAuthCodeRevokedForNonExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Verifies that checking revocation status for a non-existent auth code returns true.
